steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: Make your estimates and invoices match your brand. Pick your colour in Settings.

steps.caption: Company theme
steps.narration: Scroll to Company theme, under the company profile.

steps.caption: Twenty colours
steps.narration: There are twenty colours to choose from.

steps.caption: Click a swatch
steps.narration: Click one. It saves straight away.

steps.caption: The preview
steps.narration: The preview shows your company name and the approve button in that colour.

steps.caption: Main color
steps.narration: Main color sets the band behind your name. Choose white,

steps.caption: On white
steps.narration: and the same colour sits on a white band.

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Now look at a real document. Open Estimates,

steps.caption: Your colour
steps.narration: This is the client's view. The heading and the accents are in your colour.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find Company theme under Settings, in the left menu.

youtube.title: Set your brand colour on estimates and invoices | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Choose the accent colour for your estimates, invoices, contracts and client portal in ConstructHUB CRM, pick a black or white base, and check the result on a real estimate. The walkthrough uses a demo company and demo clients.
